question.text:
Given below are two statements : one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as
Assertion (A): A simple distillation can be used to separate a mixture of propanol and propanone.
Reason (R): Two liquids with a difference of more than 20°C in their boiling points can be separated by simple distillations.
In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below :

options.text: Both (A) and (R) are correct but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).
Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).

solution.text: Simple distilation is the method of separating mixtures based on differences in their volatilities in a boiling liquid mixture. The components in a sample mixture are vaporised by the application of heat and then immediately cooled by the action of cold water in a condenser. Two liquids with a difference of more than <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>20</mn><mo>°</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></math> in their boiling points can be separated by simple distillations.
